english.text: Cris’ comment coming through my high definition tv made me think if it was still true that “you had to be there.” Comparing what I saw in “real definition,” I can attest watching on modern television is in many ways better. The close up perspectives, sweeping panoramic shots, super slow motion replays all display the action as you could never see it from a stadium seat or standing on the sidelines.

jyutping: Cris hai2 ngo5 bou6 gou1 cing1 din6 si6 dou6 faat3 ceot1 ge3 ping4 leon6 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2「nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hai2 dou6」hai6 mai6 zung6 hai6 zan1 ge3。 bei2 gaau3 ngo5 hai2「zan1 zing3 ding6 ji6」jap6 min6 tai2 dou3 ge3 je5，ngo5 ho2 ji5 zing3 ming4 tai2 jin6 doi6 din6 si6 hai2 hou2 do1 fong1 min6 dou1 hai6 hou2 di1。 dak6 se2 si6 gok3、cyun4 ging2 geng3 tau4、ciu1 maan6 dung6 zok3 cung4 bo3 dou1 hin2 si6 ceot1 dung6 zok3，jan1 wai6 nei5 hai2 kau4 coeng4 zo6 wai2 waak6 ze2 kei5 hai2 coeng4 bin1 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 tai2 dou3。
text: Cris 喺我部高清電視度發出嘅評論令我諗起「你一定要喺度」係咪仲係真嘅。 比較我喺「真正定義」入面睇到嘅嘢，我可以證明睇現代電視喺好多方面都係好啲。 特寫視角、全景鏡頭、超慢動作重播都顯示出動作，因為你喺球場座位或者企喺場邊永遠都唔會睇到。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On a cold day, soldier Ali was standing in the camp. He was thinking about his mission: protecting the border. He knew his mission was difficult, but he had a brave heart. One day, he heard a distant explosion. Ali and his colleagues ran towards the sound. They reached the attack site, and faced the enemy. Ali was afraid, but he knew he had to defend his homeland. After a long fight, they returned to the camp. Ali was tired but happy that he had protected his homeland.

jyutping: hai2 jat1 go3 dung3 di1 ge3 jat6 zi2，si6 bing1 aa3 lei5 kei5 hai2 jing4 dei6 jap6 min6。keoi5 nam2 gan2 keoi5 ge3 si3 ming6：bou2 wu6 bin1 ging2。keoi5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 ge3 jam6 mou6 hou2 naan4，daan6 hai6 keoi5 jau5 jat1 go3 jung5 gam2 ge3 sam1。jau5 jat1 jat6，keoi5 teng1 dou3 jyun5 cyu3 jau5 go3 baau3 zaa3 seng1。aa3 lei5 tung4 keoi5 di1 tung4 si6 paau2 hoeng3 go2 go3 seng1 jam1。keoi5 dei6 dou3 daat6 gung1 gik1 dei6 dim2，bing6 min6 deoi3 maai4 di1 dik6 jan4。aa3 lei5 hou2 geng1，daan6 hai6 keoi5 zi1 dou3 keoi5 jiu3 hon5 wai6 keoi5 ge3 zou2 gwok3。ging1 gwo3 hou2 noi6 ge3 zin3 dau3，keoi5 dei6 faan2 zo2 heoi3 jing4 dei6。aa3 lei5 hou2 leoi6，daan6 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 keoi5 bou2 wu6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 zou2 gwok3。
text: 喺一個凍啲嘅日子，士兵阿里企喺營地入面。佢諗緊佢嘅使命：保護邊境。佢知道自己嘅任務好難，但係佢有一個勇敢嘅心。有一日，佢聽到遠處有個爆炸聲。阿里同佢啲同事跑向嗰個聲音。佢哋到達攻擊地點，並面對埋啲敵人。阿里好驚，但係佢知道佢要捍衛佢嘅祖國。經過好耐嘅戰鬥，佢哋返咗去營地。阿里好累，但係好開心佢保護咗佢嘅祖國。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When there was room on the ledge outside of the pots and boxes for a cat, the cat was there — in sunny weather — stretched at full length, asleep and blissful, with her furry belly to the sun and a paw curved over her nose. Then that house was complete, and its contentment and peace were made manifest to the world by this symbol, whose testimony is infallible. A home without a cat—and a well-fed, well-petted, and properly revered cat—may be a perfect home, perhaps, but how can it prove title?

jyutping: dong1 pun4 tung4 hap2 ngoi6 min6 ge3 laan4 gon1 soeng6 jau5 wai6 fong3 maau1 ge3 si4 hau6，maau1 zau6 hai2 dou6 —— hai2 cing4 long5 ge3 tin1 hei3 haa6 —— cyun4 san1 san1 zin2，fan3 zyu6 tung4 hang6 fuk1，keoi5 mou4 jung4 jung4 ge3 tou5 naam5 hoeng3 zyu6 taai3 joeng4，jat1 zek3 zaau2 waan1 hai2 keoi5 go3 bei6 soeng6 min6，jin4 hau6 go2 gaan1 uk1 zau6 jyun4 sing4 zo2，ji4 keoi5 ge3 mun5 zuk1 tung4 wo4 ping4 zau6 jau4 ni1 go3 zoeng6 zing1 hoeng3 sai3 jan4 zin2 si6，keoi5 ge3 gin3 zing3 hai6 mou4 ho2 hau5 fei1 ge3，ji4 ce2 hai6 jat1 go3 mou5 maau1 ge3 gaa1 ho2 nang4 hai6 jat1 go3 jyun4 mei5 ge3 uk1 kei2，daan6 hai6 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 zing3 ming4 ni1 go3 cing1 hou6？
text: 當盆同盒外面嘅欄杆上有位放貓嘅時候，貓就喺度 —— 喺晴朗嘅天氣下 —— 全身伸展，瞓住同幸福，佢毛茸茸嘅肚腩向住太陽，一隻爪彎喺佢個鼻上面，然後嗰間屋就完成咗，而佢嘅滿足同和平就由呢個象徵向世人展示，佢嘅見證係無可厚非嘅，而且係一個冇貓嘅家可能係一個完美嘅屋企，但係點樣可以證明呢個稱號？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Bratislav is a Croatian-derived friend of mine who is a ufologist. He has a UFO Kit on his smartphone. He has recommended me books like The Orion Regressions by Stan Romanek and The Terra Papers by Robert Morning Sky. His exotic books are of the paranormal, pseudoscience, and ufology genres. His brain is full of fascinating conspiracy theories and strange anecdotes. He has an interesting nonstandard view of astronomy. He thinks that outer space and the worlds beyond are teeming with life, whilst I conjecture that they are vast deserts wherein life, especially intelligent, is very rare. However, I am open-minded and could change my view if needed.

jyutping: Bratislav hai6 ngo5 jat1 go3 haak1 lo4 dei6 aa3 jeoi6 ge3 pang4 jau5，keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 fei1 dip2 hok6 gaa1。keoi5 hai2 keoi5 bou6 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 UFO tou3 zong1。keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 teoi1 zin3 gwo3 hou2 ci5 si1 taan2 · lo4 maan6 nei4 hak1 ge3《lip6 wu6 zo6 wui4 gwai1》tung4 lo4 baak3 dak6 · san4 tin1 ge3《dei6 kau4 man4 gin2》ni1 di1 syu1。keoi5 ge3 ji6 gwok3 syu1 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 ciu1 zi6 jin4、ngai6 fo1 hok6 tung4 fei1 dip2 hok6 ge3 leoi6 jing4。keoi5 ge3 nou5 jap6 min6 cung1 mun5 zyu6 mai4 jan4 ge3 jam1 mau4 leon6 tung4 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 kei4 man4，keoi5 deoi3 tin1 man4 hok6 jau5 jat1 zung2 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 fei1 biu1 zeon2 gun1 dim2，keoi5 jing6 wai4 ngoi6 taai3 hung1 tung4 sai3 gaai3 zi1 ngoi6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 cung1 mun5 zyu6 sang1 ming6，ji4 ngo5 teoi1 caak1，jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 ge3 gun1 dim2 hai6 gwong2 fut3 ge3，ngo5 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 ge3 waa2。
text: Bratislav 係我一個克羅地亞裔嘅朋友，佢係一個飛碟學家。佢喺佢部智能手機上面有個 UFO 套裝。佢向我推薦過好似斯坦 · 羅曼尼克嘅《獵戶座迴歸》同羅伯特 · 晨天嘅《地球文件》呢啲書。佢嘅異國書係關於超自然、偽科學同飛碟學嘅類型。佢嘅腦入面充滿住迷人嘅陰謀論同奇怪嘅奇聞，佢對天文學有一種有趣嘅非標準觀點，佢認為外太空同世界之外嘅世界充滿住生命，而我推測，如果我嘅觀點係廣闊嘅，我可以改變嘅話。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the late morning today, I see my white neighbour Bruce Lawson in front of his yard, his son Wesley's brown puppy Gus being on a leash tied to a boat. Bruce says his Filipina wife Nerria just grabbed the puppy the other night, as the brownie ran away. Wesley and his white girlfriend are still in Peru. Bruce does not know their itinerary. He says, "They just want to be in a different country." Such reminds me that in the future, would different settled worlds—planets and moons—be like different countries? I have read lots of sci-fi that do postulate such. Today is the 15th of February of 2017.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 ling4 san4，ngo5 gin3 dou2 ngo5 go3 baak6 jan4 leon4 geoi1 Bruce Lawson hai2 keoi5 go3 hau6 jyun2 cin4 min6，keoi5 go3 zai2 wai5 si1 lei6 ge3 fe1 sik1 siu2 gau2 Gus hai2 tiu4 sing2 soeng6 min6 bong2 zyu6 tiu4 syun4。 Bruce waa6 keoi5 fei1 leot6 ban1 lou5 po4 Nerria cam4 maan5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zuk1 zyu6 zek3 siu2 gau2，dong1 si4 bou3 long5 nei4 zau6 tou4 zau2 zo2。wai5 si1 lei6 tung4 keoi5 go3 baak6 jan4 neoi5 pang4 jau5 zung6 hai2 bei3 lou5。 Bruce m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 cing4。keoi5 waa6：「keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 soeng2 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 gwok3 gaa1。」ni1 di1 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2，hai2 mei6 loi4，m4 tung4 ge3 ding6 geoi1 sai3 gaai3 — haang4 sing1 tung4 jyut6 loeng6 — wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 ci5 m4 tung4 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 gam2？ngo5 tai2 gwo3 hou2 do1 fo1 waan6 pin3 dou1 gaa2 cit3 zo2 gam2 ge3 je5。gam1 jat6 hai6 2017 nin4 2 jyut6 15 hou6。
text: 今日凌晨，我見到我個白人鄰居 Bruce Lawson 喺佢個後院前面，佢個仔韋斯利嘅啡色小狗 Gus 喺條繩上面綁住條船。 Bruce 話佢菲律賓老婆 Nerria 尋晚啱啱捉住隻小狗，當時布朗尼就逃走咗。韋斯利同佢個白人女朋友仲喺秘魯。 Bruce 唔知佢哋嘅行程。佢話：「佢哋只係想喺唔同嘅國家。」呢啲令我諗起，喺未來，唔同嘅定居世界 — 行星同月亮 — 會唔會好似唔同嘅國家噉？我睇過好多科幻片都假設咗噉嘅嘢。今日係2017年2月15號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Mary, history says that the Roman Empire had bread and circuses for the masses, but really it was a vast conspiracy by the Roman oligarchy to change the very structure of Latin itself. By using a method of 'pronounic decoupling', the implicit mechanisms of Latin were disengaged and its speakers were hardly ever able to understand each other. And that's why I got drunk last night," said Tom.

jyutping: 「Mary，lik6 si2 waa6 lo4 maa5 dai3 gwok3 jung6 min6 baau1 tung4 maa5 hei3 tyun4 lai4 mun5 zuk1 daai6 zung3，daan6 kei4 sat6 hai6 lo4 maa5 gwaa2 tau4 zaap6 tyun4 jat1 go3 geoi6 daai6 jam1 mau4，muk6 dik1 hai6 goi2 bin3 laai1 ding1 man2 bun2 san1 ge3 git3 kau3。keoi5 dei6 jung6 jat1 zung2 giu3『doi6 ming4 ci4 gaai2 ngau5』ge3 fong1 faat3，zoeng1 laai1 ding1 man2 noi6 zoi6 gei1 zai3 caak3 saan3，ling6 gong2 ze2 zi1 gaan1 gei1 fu4 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 ming4 baak6 deoi3 fong1。so2 ji5 ngo5 kam4 maan5 sin1 zi3 jam2 zeoi3 zo2，」Tom gong2。
text: 「Mary，歷史話羅馬帝國用麵包同馬戲團嚟滿足大眾，但其實係羅馬寡頭集團一個巨大陰謀，目的係改變拉丁文本身嘅結構。佢哋用一種叫『代名詞解耦』嘅方法，將拉丁文內在機制拆散，令講者之間幾乎完全聽唔明白對方。所以我琴晚先至飲醉咗，」Tom 講。
